description: This file defines a plugin for the Trumbowyg WYSIWYG editor that adds mention functionality, including language support, dropdown building, and formatting functions.

methods.name: buildDropdown
methods.description: Builds a dropdown list of mention items for the editor.

methods.name: formatDropdownItem
methods.description: Formats an item for display in the dropdown list.

methods.name: formatResult
methods.description: Formats an item for insertion into the editor content.
